The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 989f14096403897c), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. statement: For every even L ≥ 4, let HL be a non-scalar finite-dimensional self-adjoint Hamiltonian. Suppose that a ∈ ℝ and, for each b > 0, a real finite or countable list (λi(b)) satisfy ∑ i |λi(b)|4 < ∞, ZL(b) := Tr e−b(HL+aLI) = ∑ i |λi(b)|L (L ≥ 4 even). Define S, T by (4.1) and G by (4.8). Let n0 ≥ 4 be even, b0 > 0, and let u0, C satisfy 0 < u0 < 1 6 , G(u0) ≤ C, r := Cu0 < 1, C(1 − 3u0) > 3. (4.10) Suppose S(n0, b0) ≥ 1 − u0, T(2n0, b0) ≥ 1 − u0. (4.11) For j ≥ 0, set nj = 2j n0, bj = 2j b0, uj = C−1 r2j . (4.12) Then S(nj, bj) ≥ 1 − uj, T(2nj, bj) ≥ 1 − uj. (4.13) For every even L ≥ n0, the physical ground state is unique, and the gap above it satisfies γL > log(1/r) b0 . (4.14)
